campaign_cost.scope: corpus preparation, training, gradient audits, all evaluation and greedy generation; excludes module import and final JSON serialization

architecture.tokenizer: literal UTF-8 bytes, no learned vocabulary or normalization

evaluation.candidate_gain_criterion: dual must improve each heldout document in every paired seed at both replacement counts; exploratory criterion only, no broad P5 qualification
evaluation.checkpoint_rule: final fixed update; no test-set checkpoint or hyperparameter selection

hypotheses.capacity: C-P=u-1 yields global function/first-Jacobian isomorphism for immediate affine consumers
hypotheses.end_to_end: compare heldout next-byte prediction after training embeddings, attention, internal activation blocks and decoder together
hypotheses.optimizer: canonical-coordinate Put+linear has equivalent full-network gradients and Adam updates; native-coordinate Adam need not

limitations: The closed negative hypotheses are scoped questions, not production or entire-phase gate closure.
Only a 32k-parameter two-block byte generator trained from scratch on 55k bytes of related project prose.
One and two FFNs are replaced; attention remains causal attention. No autonomous spiking or optimal-QVI training.
Only full 65-byte overlap is removed; shared short phrases, vocabulary, and subject matter remain.
Heldout documents and windows are reused across training seeds and modes; do not count them as independent corpora.
Equal parameters, target tokens and updates do not imply equal transcendental-operation or backward FLOPs.
Per-mode CPU/wall training includes validation and gradient receipt copies; paired audit overhead is separately described, no latency win is claimed.
Shared host clocks/RSS are descriptive; no energy, production p99, large-model training, or quality-cost frontier is certified.
